reason: Complete-source review found the candidate accurate on table families and grain, invoice and breakdown snapshots, identity and time-selection signals, nullability, completeness boundaries, canonical URL, newest-first raw history, exact backlinks, transition-enum scope, and the prepaid-threshold and alert deltas.
